reason: The plan at every moment: the update selection writes its line about an Instance only after Enabled says a sink takes it, so the values of a line no sink takes are not copied into interface records per Instance, five to nine allocations per Instance at every moment. The Plan rows at 4,000 single-pod Instances: idle 31,818 to 8,074, mid-roll 19,839 to 4,095, fresh 39,546 to 4,106, scale-up 33,821 to 7,099, mid-roll-podless 43,600 to 8,160; at 160 gangs of eight: 1,798 / 1,171 / 1,316 / 1,684 / 1,502 to 998 / 691 / 209 / 813 / 395. BuildPlan and the publication stand as recorded: the publication costs 2 allocations per single-pod Instance and 6 per gang of 8, plus one allocation of 24 bytes per Instance for the copy of its readySince. Re-recorded on 2026-11-06 for the Plan rows: the update selection's reading of each Instance already on the target counts the pods of the target's runner layout without copying it and keeps the pods on the target without copying the Instance's pod list (ComponentPlan.TotalPodsFor, ops.rolledSetPods), two allocations per Instance fewer per Plan: at 4,000 single-pod Instances idle 8,074 to 74, mid-roll 4,095 to 95, fresh 4,106 to 106, scale-up 7,099 to 99, mid-roll-podless 8,160 to 4,160; at 160 gangs of eight idle 998 to 678, mid-roll 691 to 531, fresh 209 to 49, scale-up 813 to 533, mid-roll-podless 395 to 235. BuildPlan and the publication stand as recorded. Re-recorded with the layout read in place: an Instance's layout at a revision that changes no width in it is the plan's own layout, not a copy (ComponentPlan.RunnersFor), so BuildPlan allocates nothing per Instance for its layout; the BuildPlan rows alone move: 4000x1 idle and mid-roll 8,299 to 4,299, fresh 4,082 to 82, scale-up 7,202 to 3,202; 160x8 idle and mid-roll 402 to 242, fresh 201 to 41, scale-up 363 to 203; the Plan and the publication rows unchanged. Re-recorded with the create pass counting a gang's live pods without a list (query.LivePodCount where createRevision read len(query.ExcludeTerminalPods(...))): one allocation less per gang with pods, so the Plan rows at 160x8 move, idle 678 to 518, mid-roll 531 to 371, scale-up 533 to 413; the single-pod shapes, BuildPlan and the publication rows unchanged. Re-recorded with the plan's index selection reading its rows in place (where each index's row sits kept instead of a copy of every row, the failed gang surge sources read once, the set of taken indexes skipped when the count is filled): the BuildPlan rows alone move, 160x8/fresh/BuildPlan 41 to 36; 160x8/idle/BuildPlan 242 to 31; 160x8/mid-roll/BuildPlan 242 to 31; 160x8/scale-up/BuildPlan 203 to 35; 4000x1/fresh/BuildPlan 82 to 77; 4000x1/idle/BuildPlan 4,299 to 87; 4000x1/mid-roll/BuildPlan 4,299 to 87; 4000x1/scale-up/BuildPlan 3,202 to 82; the Plan and the publication rows unchanged. Re-recorded with the publication building no list per Instance: every row's node list is cut from one array the publication fills (status.AppendUniqueNodes), the pods that report are read in place when none is left out, and the live pods are counted without a list (query.LivePodCount), so a publication costs 3 allocations whatever the Instance count and the gang size, plus the converter's copy of each readySince: 1000x1 uniform 2,001 → 3 and readySince 3,001 → 1,003, 4000x1 8,001 → 3 and 12,001 → 4,003, 160x8 959 → 3 and 1,119 → 163; bytes 220,696 → 213,088, 244,696 → 237,088, 866,136 → 835,680, 962,136 → 931,680, 82,728 → 54,624, 86,568 → 58,464. The plan rows stand as recorded.
